name: Blessed
tagline: Twenty-one apartments planned for the room of a villa.
description: Blessed is a completed apartment development in Vijayanagar 4th Stage. Its twenty-one homes are 2 and 3 BHK, planned around light and cross-ventilation to feel villa-like in their expansiveness.

items: 1200 × 1200 mm premium vitrified tiles to living and common areas
Glazed tiles to bathroom walls, full height
Main door in teak wood frame with veneer finish
Internal doors in wood frame with laminate finish
WPC frames and shutters to toilets
